# RareDigital — AI & Performance Marketing Agency

> Ludhiana's first AI-powered performance marketing agency. We build high-converting websites, 3D landing pages, automated marketing workflows, autonomous AI agents, and ROI-driven Meta & Google ad campaigns.

## Core Services

- **SEO & Organic Search (SEO)**: Full-funnel search engine optimization, technical SEO, entity schema markup, and local pack ranking in Ludhiana, Punjab & nationwide.
- **Paid Ads (PPC)**: High-efficiency Meta Ads (Instagram/Facebook) and Google Search/Display Ads optimized for low CPA and maximum ROAS.
- **AI Web Design**: Fast, modern, responsive AI-crafted websites built for conversion and search authority.
- **3D Animated Landing Pages**: Interactive, high-converting 3D landing pages with sub-second performance.
- **Marketing Automation**: Custom automated lead nurture workflows, CRM integrations, and automated email/SMS follow-up systems.
- **Autonomous AI Agents**: Custom 24/7 AI chatbots, WhatsApp conversational agents, and lead qualifying bots.
